name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B
notes: Llama-3.1-70B architecture verbatim (LlamaForCausalLM, hidden 8192, 80 layers, 64 query heads / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128 stated explicitly in config.json). gqa_ratio = 64 / 8 = 8. rope_theta 500000, no rope_scaling. KV bytes/token at bf16 (2 bytes/element): 80 layers x 8 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes = 327680 B/token = 320.0 KiB/token. At 128k context that is 40.00 GiB of KV for one sequence at bf16, against 140.6 GiB of weights at fp16 - KV dominates at long context.
